faq.q: How do I install Jetpack Joyride on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Jetpack Joyride and check the developer is Halfbrick Studios before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Halfbrick Studios and may be altered, so the safest way to play Jetpack Joyride is the official listing.
Yes. It's free on Google Play with ads and optional purchases. Everything important can be earned with coins from runs.

faq.q: What are the best vehicles in Jetpack Joyride?
faq.a: The Strong Arm Machine (S.A.M.) and Lil' Stomper are favourites. Each vehicle acts as an extra life, so any vehicle is worth grabbing.

faq.q: How do I level up fast?
faq.a: Complete the three missions you're given, because finishing them raises your rank. Swap hard missions with coins if they block you.
